items.title: Apple (AAPL) Reaches $250 Million Siri Settlement Over Recent iPhone Claims
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) agreed to a US$250 million class action settlement tied to Siri and Apple Intelligence features in recent iPhones. The deal covers a broad group of U.S. buyers of recent iPhone models who claimed they were misled about Siri feature access. Settlement terms include creation of a dedicated fund, with payouts subject to court approval and claimant eligibility rules.
